themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Crisis Spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints in Sunset Park spiked to 13 reports last week versus a baseline of 1.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1056% increase (z-score: 8.71)—signaling a potential public health, sanitation, or wildlife management problem that emerged THIS WEEK.
evidence: 13 dead animal complaints last week vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
z-score of 8.71 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
1056% spike suggests acute event rather than gradual trend
reporting_angles: Ground reporting: where are dead animals concentrated? (waterfront, parks, streets?) and what species?
Department of Sanitation response: how quickly are complaints being cleared and what's the underlying cause?

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints jumped to 9 reports THIS WEEK compared to a baseline of 1.8 per week—a 414% spike (z-score: 6.05)—suggesting accelerated unauthorized tree removal or damage in the district.
evidence: 9 illegal tree damage complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.8 weekly baseline
414% spike with z-score of 6.05 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Aligns with active development and rezoning projects (Coney Island Ave, Fourth Ave) that may involve site prep
reporting_angles: Link to development pipeline: are ongoing ULURPs and construction permits driving unauthorized tree removal?
Parks Dept enforcement: how many violations have been issued and what penalties apply?

themes_detail.label: Curb Condition Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints reached 8 reports last week versus 2.4 per week average over 8 weeks—a 237% spike (z-score: 5.06)—indicating rapid street infrastructure decline in Sunset Park over the PAST 2 WEEKS.
evidence: 8 curb condition complaints last week vs. 2.4 weekly baseline
Aligns with long-running community board requests for street infrastructure upgrades and reflects ongoing street condition complaints (443 total over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Field assessment: which blocks or corridors show worst deterioration and safety impacts?
DOT maintenance schedules: has curb repair work stalled or been delayed?

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dog Incidents
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints peaked at 3 reports 2 weeks ago versus a baseline of 0.1 per week—a 2300% spike (z-score: 8.69)—concentrated in parks and public spaces over the PAST 2 WEEKS, raising public safety and animal control concerns.
evidence: 3 unleashed dog complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly baseline
Converges with noise-in-park spike (5 complaints 3 weeks ago, 1233% increase), suggesting park usage or enforcement changes
reporting_angles: NYPD Animal Care & Control response: has enforcement capacity changed? Are dog owners facing citations?
Park-goers: interview residents about safety concerns and whether specific parks are problem areas

themes_detail.label: Park Noise & Amenity Gap
themes_detail.summary: Noise-in-park complaints spiked to 5 reports 3 weeks ago versus 0.4 weekly average—a 1233% increase (z-score: 6.65)—overlapping with community board's repeated multi-year funding requests for expanded parks and outdoor amenities, suggesting unmet neighborhood recreation demand.
evidence: 5 park noise complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (1233% spike, z-score: 6.65)
Community board has requested 'new or expanded park/playground/outdoor athletic field' in every budget cycle for multiple years
Aligns with 'Walk to Park' site selection ULURP currently in public review phase, indicating district-wide parks access gap
reporting_angles: Community board + Parks Dept: what is the status of the Walk to Park initiative and why has park investment lagged in this district?
Residents: document how overcrowded parks are driving noise conflicts and whether new families feel adequately served
